summary: Baileys-family WhatsApp library with weak static pattern match
details: Package is a fork/derivative of the Baileys WhatsApp Web library. The single static hit fires on keyword co-occurrence (`ping`, `GET`, `id`) across widely separated lines of lib/Utils/generics.js, which is the expected shape for a WhatsApp protocol utility module (keepalive ping frames, HTTP GET helpers, message id handling). No hardcoded non-first-party exfiltration endpoint, no credential/home-directory scanning, no lifecycle scripts, and no install-time or import-time fetch-and-execute path are present in the evidence. The pattern match reflects normal protocol-library composition rather than a demonstrated attacker-benefit mechanism against the installer.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
